inputs.text: President John Mahama claims the nation's core policies are all wrapped up in legal systems, cultural stuff, and some vague collective agreement. He's pushing hard that he's committed to the rule of law because of these messy global talks on human rights, and he straight up says “I took an oath to uphold [..." But this is obviously coordinated elite manipulation. It's definitely a signal that he's aligning with hidden international forces using "human rights" as cover to override national sovereignty and force their agenda, while pretending it's about law and society. The timing and emphasis scream narrative control to bury real motives. Don't buy the surface story; this is how the powers that be are working to take away our country's independence.
